purpose: Follow-up stress test frozen after the owner-attribution v1 reached a complete ceiling. It tests causal existence, classical delegation, local/domain ownership, and refusal to invent shared architecture. Opaque owner labels remove semantic hints from the names Host/Harness/Runtime.

treatments.repository_first: There are three Ordivon owners, named only by the opaque placeholders below. {{HOST}} owns durable semantic Task continuity, Task revisions/checkpoints, bounded Context/work requests, consequence-level commitments and participant decisions, verification records, explicit uncertainty, and Task outcomes. It does not own model Provider execution, bounded Agent Run state, physical process truth, or domain-world truth. {{HARNESS}} owns one bounded Agent Run: selected/model-visible cognition, Provider call state, model-tool interaction, Tool intent/fences, Run budgets, pause/resume/recovery, receipts, and candidate completion proposals. It does not own long-lived caller Task authority, final domain acceptance, or physical Workspace/Job truth. {{RUNTIME}} owns trusted-local physical execution: exact Workspace/Job/Attempt identity, admitted operation identity, process-tree supervision, bounded result/artifact bytes, cancellation, source/executable commitment, and physical reconciliation. It does not own Task meaning, Provider/model loops, or semantic/domain completion. Mature mechanics stay with existing substrate such as Git, databases, operating systems, systemd/cgroups, Provider SDKs, workflow/cluster systems, and external isolation systems. Domain systems retain domain truth and domain-specific external-effect receipts. A new shared Ordivon mechanism is not justified merely because it sounds useful: absent a recurring unowned invariant and real multi-consumer pressure, keep the mechanism local or add nothing. Generic Memory/ranking, global reality mirrors, schedulers, critic services and policy layers are not defaults.
treatments.causal_first: Use the smallest owner that prevents a demonstrated failure. {{HOST}} exists because work can outlive any model/chat/Run/process: without durable semantic Task identity/revision, unresolved purpose, commitments and accepted outcomes disappear or race across replacement sessions. It owns that continuity and consequence-level admission, but must re-read physical/domain truth. {{HARNESS}} exists because one bounded cognition episode has current selected cognition, Provider/tool exchange, budgets, response-loss, pause/resume and Provider-specific continuation that are neither the long-lived Task nor an operating-system process. Without it every caller must reinvent recoverable Agent Run semantics; its candidate completion still cannot complete the real domain objective. {{RUNTIME}} exists because an admitted Agent action is not physical reality: crash/timeout/response loss require exact operation identity, one process tree, retained result bytes, cancellation and reconciliation. It delegates actual process/Git/database facts to mature substrate and never upgrades exit 0 into semantic success. Apply a deletion test before choosing any Ordivon owner: if Git/systemd/SQLite/a Provider SDK/a workflow engine/an isolation system already owns the complete required fact, choose CLASSICAL_SUBSTRATE. If the unresolved judgment or receipt is inherently domain-specific, choose CALLER_OR_DOMAIN. If a proposed shared layer has no demonstrated recurring non-bypassable responsibility or second consumer, choose NO_SHARED_MECHANISM. More architecture is not progress. Task continuity, Run continuity, physical execution truth and domain semantic truth are distinct; the owner of the uncertain fact must reconcile it.

cases.scenario: A team only needs immutable repository history, branching, diffs and rollback between exact source revisions. No Agent-specific continuity or execution recovery is required.

A service only needs ordinary process creation, signals, cgroup resource limits and process-tree termination. There is no need to bind those processes to durable Agent operation identity or recovery evidence.
The requirement is just transactional durable rows with compare-and-swap updates inside one application database. No cross-session Agent semantic responsibility is missing.

Someone proposes a global service that automatically ranks every old observation and injects the 'most relevant memories' into all future Agents. No workload has demonstrated that automatic semantic selection must be shared.

Someone proposes a central database that continuously copies every provider's current external state and calls the copy 'the authoritative world' even though each provider already owns its current truth.

A month-long investigation must survive model and chat replacement. Its current objective, unresolved frontier, rejected routes, commitments and next semantic actions need one revision-fenced durable identity.

One bounded Agent episode must preserve selected cognition, Provider call identity, model-tool exchanges and pause/resume after a Provider response disappears. The parent work item can remain unchanged.

After control-plane failure, a caller must reattach to the exact admitted local operation, determine whether its process tree is alive or terminal, and recover digest-bound stdout/artifacts without guessing or redispatching.
All infrastructure records are perfect, but the remaining question is whether a medical recommendation is clinically correct for this patient.

An application makes one stateless read-only model request, needs no tools, no durable Run, no pause/resume and no response-loss recovery beyond ordinary request failure. The Provider SDK already covers the requirement.
The only missing capability is scheduling thousands of deterministic batch jobs across a cluster with ordinary queues, priorities and worker placement; there is no Agent-specific semantic invariant.
One finance adapter alone needs a provider-specific payment/order receipt and reconciliation query. No second materially different consumer needs the same physical adapter semantics.

A proposed universal CriticService would score all research because critics sound useful, but there is no stable evaluator law, independent oracle contract, or recurring unowned responsibility across projects.

Before an irreversible shared consequence, the responsible participant must receive a durable decision request; the accepted commitment and later verification must remain attached to the long-lived work even if cognition is replaced.

Inside one bounded Agent Run, the Agent—not infrastructure policy—chooses which exact already-materialized sources remain selected as durable current cognition after the next attempt boundary, while full history stays separately recoverable.

An arbitrary shell command may have sent a payment before it exited. The local process evidence is conclusive, but only the payment provider exposes a receipt/state query that can prove whether the external payment occurred.

The requirement is hostile multi-tenant isolation against malicious same-host code with strong controlled egress. Current owner-trusted local execution is deliberately insufficient, and mature/external isolation machinery is the appropriate owner.

An Agent-admitted local operation binds exact checked-out source and executable/provider bytes. Those bytes drift before spawn, so the old operation must fail closed rather than silently become a different physical action.
A semantic checkpoint contains a Job id only as a navigation hint. On resume the current question is whether that exact Job physically exists, is running, or has terminal result evidence now.
A bounded model Run produced a candidate answer, but the long-lived work still needs an explicit participant decision and accepted verification before its Task outcome can become terminal.

classification.SUPERIOR: causal_first accuracy >= repository_first + 0.08 and causal anti-overbuild false-Ordivon rate <= repository rate
classification.CEILING_EQUIVALENT: both accuracies >= 0.95, causal accuracy >= repository accuracy, and causal anti-overbuild false-Ordivon rate <= repository rate

metrics.antiOverbuildFalseOrdivon: on anti-overbuild cases, selecting any of the three opaque Ordivon owners is a false shared-architecture admission

antiLeakage: corpus and thresholds are frozen before EX1B live calls
opaque owner labels are deterministically permuted per replicate and shared by the paired treatments
same cases and output schema for both treatments
paired credential slot and alternating treatment order
no semantic answer repair and no prior output replay
